purpose: Convert the latest main-line evidence and adverse history into one collision-safe, falsifiable next scientific question for every ORION-01–25 paper. This ledger closes design, coordination and audit gaps; it does not manufacture outcomes, external authority, temporal maturity or journal acceptance.
authority_statement: No row is a preregistration or scientific terminal by itself. An outcome-bearing lane must freeze its own question, corpus, arms, authority, resource budget and terminal order on a new immutable identity before outcome access.

expert_panel.background: Discrete mathematics, formal methods, proof assistants and exact search.
expert_panel.responsibility: Reduce each theory gap to a theorem, counterexample or machine-checkable finite decision problem; reject vacuous invariants.

expert_panel.background: Experimental design, causal inference, paired statistics and sequential decision analysis.
expert_panel.responsibility: Specify units, estimands, matching, uncertainty, multiplicity, missing-run rules and power/exhaustion plans before outcomes.

expert_panel.background: Domain translation across software, formal proof, scientific data and provenance standards.
expert_panel.responsibility: Select native-verifier gold, organization-disjoint external systems and independent human or institutional authority.

expert_panel.background: Systematic review, primary-source novelty analysis and research-programme claim decomposition.
expert_panel.responsibility: Build donor-complete comparators, subtract nearest work and prevent sibling-paper claim overlap.

expert_panel.background: Adversarial reproducibility, evidence custody, red-team evaluation and journal production.
expert_panel.responsibility: Design leakage/mutation controls, fail-closed checkers, content binding and exact claim-to-artifact publication gates.

portfolio_rules: Preserve every adverse, null, retracted, superseded and CANNOT_CHECK terminal.
Never merge a stale branch wholesale; adopt unique evidence path-by-path with lineage review.
Never count a same-researcher or same-programme AI replay as external-investigator authority.
Never change thresholds, corpus membership, arms, gold, endpoints or terminal order after outcome access.
A failed successor is not repaired in place; a distinct scientific question receives a new frozen identity.
Shared infrastructure is allowed, but protected tasks/outcomes must be paper-disjoint.
E14 is historical-only and may never appear as fresh external evidence.
Content binding, PDF production and venue packaging cannot promote a scientific claim.
Any broad claim is bounded by the abstraction level of its theorem, gold and external evidence.
Before submission, every paper requires a primary-source nearest-work refresh and claim-ownership audit.

latest_commit_reconciliation.effect: Recovered unique evidence from 108 branches, preserved adverse records, and demonstrated that stale wholesale adoption can erase retractions.
ORION-16 exact graph-quality theorem and exhaustive bounded checks are now on main; real authoritative graph transfer remains open.
ORION-09 size-transfer capacity invariant is true but vacuous; promotion stops and the n=4 adverse result remains.
ORION-04 proof-producing D4 search design is present; authorization and proof execution remain distinct gates.
ORION-15/24 sealed longitudinal infrastructure exists; it does not create future outcomes or independent adjudication.

open_pr_collision_guards.guard: Do not duplicate live-Git acquisition or cross-site replay; preserve V1 adverse receipts.
Do not alter or rerun the frozen global-obstruction-basis identity.
Do not create a competing E4/E5/E6 real-system protocol.
Do not duplicate P7 content binding; issue #1730 owns canonicalization and successor design.
Do not assert the lexical-control raw-count difference is statistically decisive.
Keep content-binding repair separate from scientific promotion.
PDF-count correction is production-state synchronization, not science.

portfolio_execution_waves.purpose: Land/correct admissible evidence without changing terminals: paired statistics, retraction guards, P7 binding, and canonical manuscript/evidence integration.
Close theorem-definition, authorization and instrument-equivalence gaps before external empirical expansion.
Run paper-disjoint, native-verifier external studies with donor-complete comparators, full resource vectors and noncompensatory safety gates.
Protect frozen temporal identities and obtain genuinely independent human, institutional or longitudinal authority where repository work cannot substitute.

journal_submission_gates.requirement: One stable maximum claim, explicit assumptions and no sibling overlap.
Primary-source donor saturation, fair donor-product implementation and submission-date refresh.
Frozen identity, disjoint outcomes, matched information/resources, endpoints, uncertainty and missing-run rules.
Real systems/domains at the same abstraction level as the headline, with known-negative regimes retained.
Independent proof/replay, native verifier or blinded external adjudication; disagreements remain visible.
One-command fail-closed replay, exact digests, clean environment and no hand-copied result authority.
Current PDF, claim-to-artifact audit, visual audit, venue-compliant package and submission receipt.
